headline: Blanked, but with chances
record_line: Yesterday: 0-3 on the top plays · Season: 51-208

entries.headline: Ketel Marte stayed in the yard
entries.story: Ketel Marte went 1-for-5 against Kyle Freeland and the Colorado Rockies. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Shea Langeliers came close
entries.story: Shea Langeliers went 3-for-5 with 1 RBI against Yusei Kikuchi and the Los Angeles Angels. Closest call was a double in the 6th: "Shea Langeliers doubles (20) on a line drive to left fielder Bryce Teodosio." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Ben Rice stayed in the yard
entries.story: Ben Rice went 0-for-4 against Drew Rasmussen and the Tampa Bay Rays. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 3 times.
